name: query_database
description: Retrieve database records from a table with field selection, status and region filters, numeric ranges, temporal filters, sorting, and result limits.

table.description: Name of the database table to query.

select.description: Fields to return in each record.

status.description: Filter records by status, such as failed or completed.

region.description: Filter records by geographic or business region.

created_after.description: Lower bound for record creation time, in ISO-8601 format.

created_before.description: Upper bound for record creation time, in ISO-8601 format.

descending.description: Whether records should be ordered newest first or in descending order.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

offset.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

distinct.description: Whether duplicate result rows should be removed.

include_nulls.description: Whether records containing null values should be included.
